description:
Search notes and logs and summarise thread activity, returning pointers with metadata rather than document bodies.

Subcommands:
  notes [--thread THREAD] [--type TYPE] [--text TEXT] [--limit N] [--since YYYY-MM-DD] [--until YYYY-MM-DD] [--json] — find notes by thread, type, date range or text
  logs [--thread THREAD] [--text TEXT] [--limit N] [--since YYYY-MM-DD] [--until YYYY-MM-DD] [--json] — find daily logs by thread, date range or text
  activity [--thread THREAD] [--since YYYY-MM-DD] [--until YYYY-MM-DD] [--json] — rank threads by what happened in a window
  overview THREAD [--limit N] [--since YYYY-MM-DD] [--until YYYY-MM-DD] [--json] — the whole picture of one thread
  stream [--thread THREAD] [--kind KINDS] [--text TEXT] [--today] [--reverse] [--limit N] [--since YYYY-MM-DD] [--until YYYY-MM-DD] [--json] — every dated record merged into one chronology

Flags:
  notes: --thread thread name, 'Kind/Name', or wikilink; --type note type such as Meeting, case-insensitive; --text case-insensitive literal over topic and body; --limit max results, default 20, 0 for all.
  logs: --thread as above; --text case-insensitive literal over entry lines; --limit default 20, 0 for all.
  activity: --thread limits to one thread.
  overview: --limit recent items to list, default 5.
  stream: --kind comma-separated from note, log, task, done, hours, payment, thread, person, pending — default all; --text case-insensitive literal over thread and summary; --today shorthand for --since and --until today; --reverse oldest first, default newest first; --limit default 100, 0 for all.
  All subcommands: --since / --until are YYYY-MM-DD inclusive bounds; --json emits JSON.

Examples:
  ["notes", "--thread", "Projects/SGB", "--text", "invoice", "--json"]
  ["stream", "--thread", "Projects/SGB", "--kind", "note,log", "--limit", "20"]
  ["overview", "Processes/Admin", "--json"]
  ["activity", "--since", "2026-06-01"]

Notes:
  Paths are emitted absolute and can be handed straight to a file reader; do not re-resolve them against the working directory.
  Dates filtered on are the event date from a note's frontmatter timestamp, not the file's creation date; the filename date is used only when the frontmatter date is missing or malformed.
  Hours entry descriptions are not indexed — --text will not find them.
  Exit 1 when a thread argument cannot be resolved or --kind names an unknown kind.
